CONSOLE_ACCESS.description: serve, with CONSOLE_SIGN_IN: the access file, read again at each request. Default access.yaml beside CONSOLE_FACTORY. Without a valid file with an admin nobody signs in.

CONSOLE_BRANCH.description: serve: the branch where the factory definition changes.

CONSOLE_FACTORY.description: serve: the factory definition that /factory shows, read-only.

CONSOLE_FACTORY_COMMAND.description: serve: the command line of factory-spec's factory, which /skills and /skills/<name> run with skills --file <CONSOLE_FACTORY> (ADR 0141), and a change with edit --file <the newest factory.yaml> (ADR 0144).

CONSOLE_FACTORY_CACHE.description: serve, with CONSOLE_FACTORY_REPOSITORY: the folder of the console's copy of the factory's repository. Default: a folder per repository below the system's temporary folder.

CONSOLE_FACTORY_PATH.description: serve: the path of the factory definition in its Git repository.

CONSOLE_FACTORY_REPOSITORY.description: serve: the factory's repository on a forge as git+<url>#<branch>, like git+https://github.com/acme/factory.git#main. With it, /changes proposes a change of the factory as a pull request into that branch (ADR 0144); without it the factory is a local folder and the console changes nothing.

CONSOLE_FACTORY_TOKEN.description: serve, with CONSOLE_FACTORY_REPOSITORY: the forge token of the changes, the forge adapter's FORGE_TOKEN for them. It writes the contents and the pull requests of the repository and reads its branch's rules; the console fetches the repository with it too (ADR 0142).

CONSOLE_FACTORY_USER.description: serve, with CONSOLE_FACTORY_REPOSITORY: the user of CONSOLE_FACTORY_TOKEN as the forge adapter names an author, like forgejo:factory-bot or github:acme-factory. /changes lists only its pull requests.

CONSOLE_FOREMAN_TOKEN.description: serve: the foreman's FOREMAN_API_TOKEN, sent as Authorization: Bearer <token>; several, comma-separated, in the order of CONSOLE_FOREMAN_URL, or one for all.

CONSOLE_FOREMAN_URL.description: serve: the base URL of a foreman's API, or several, comma-separated, one per factory. Required.

CONSOLE_FORGE_ADAPTER.description: serve: the command line of the forge port's adapter that /inbox runs with prs (ADR 0073).

CONSOLE_FORGE_TOKEN.description: serve: the adapter's FORGE_TOKEN; a token that may read pull requests is enough.

CONSOLE_FORGE_URL.description: serve: the forge's API, the adapter's FORGE_URL, like https://codeberg.org for forge-forgejo. Default: the adapter's own.

CONSOLE_GATEKEEPER_URL.description: serve: the base URL of gatekeeper's API. Set, a run's page shows each gate's state and who it waits for.

CONSOLE_GITHUB_API_URL.description: serve, with CONSOLE_SIGN_IN=github: GitHub's API, from which the console reads the person's verified primary email.

CONSOLE_GITHUB_CLIENT_ID.description: serve, with CONSOLE_SIGN_IN=github: the client ID of the GitHub OAuth app. Its callback address is <CONSOLE_URL>/signin/callback.

CONSOLE_GITHUB_CLIENT_SECRET.description: serve, with CONSOLE_SIGN_IN=github: the OAuth app's client secret.

CONSOLE_GITHUB_URL.description: serve, with CONSOLE_SIGN_IN=github: GitHub's address for the sign-in, for GitHub Enterprise Server.

CONSOLE_GROUPS.description: doctor and /health: the groups file of the factory's gatekeeper, like /factory/groups.json. Set, a group without a member but the example's slack:U0EXAMPLE fails the check groups.

CONSOLE_HARNESS_COMMAND.description: doctor --deep: the command line, run with sh -c, that starts the harness's ACP agent, like claude-code-acp; it must answer ACP initialize within 10 seconds.

CONSOLE_IMPROVE_DIR.description: serve: the folder the improvement jobs write run records and scores to. Set, the page /improvement shows each scorer's pass rate and judge cost and each run's stages with their cost.

CONSOLE_INBOX_PREFIX.description: serve: the start of the branch names that /inbox lists.

CONSOLE_INBOX_REPOSITORY.description: serve: the repository of observer's pull requests, as <owner>/<name>, like acme/factory. Set, /inbox lists its open proposals.

CONSOLE_INTAKE_URL.description: serve: the base URL of intake's API. Set, a run's page lists every request of its work item.

CONSOLE_LINKS.description: serve: the dashboards every page links, as name=url, comma-separated, like Grafana=https://grafana.acme.dev.

CONSOLE_MODEL_TOKEN.description: doctor --deep: the gateway's key, sent as Authorization: Bearer <token>.

CONSOLE_MODEL_URL.description: doctor --deep: the OpenAI-compatible base URL of the model gateway (LiteLLM), ending in /v1; it gets one chat completion of one token per model route of the factory definition.

CONSOLE_NATS_URL.description: doctor --deep: the NATS server of the factory, like nats://nats:4222. Set, doctor --deep publishes one doctor.ping@v1 on osf.doctor.ping.v1 and waits 10 s for a foreman of CONSOLE_FOREMAN_URL to show it at GET /v1/doctor/pings/{id}.

CONSOLE_OIDC_CLIENT_ID.description: serve, with CONSOLE_SIGN_IN=oidc: the console's client at the provider. Its callback address is <CONSOLE_URL>/signin/callback.

CONSOLE_OIDC_CLIENT_SECRET.description: serve, with CONSOLE_SIGN_IN=oidc: the client's secret.

CONSOLE_OIDC_ISSUER.description: serve, with CONSOLE_SIGN_IN=oidc: the provider's issuer, whose discovery document is <issuer>/.well-known/openid-configuration, like https://accounts.google.com.

CONSOLE_OTLP_URL.description: doctor --deep: the OTLP/HTTP base URL of the collector, like http://jaeger:4318; it gets one span "console doctor" of the service "console" at /v1/traces.

CONSOLE_REFRESH.description: serve: the seconds after which the browser reloads the runs pages; 0 turns the reload off.

CONSOLE_REPOSITORY_URL.description: serve: the web URL of the factory's Git repository, like https://github.com/acme/factory. Set, the configuration pages link the file.

CONSOLE_SANDBOX_COMMAND.description: doctor --deep: the command line, run with sh -c, of a sandbox adapter, like sandbox-docker. Set, doctor --deep runs its probe <template> example.com, which starts a sandbox with no allowed host, and wants "refused example.com".

CONSOLE_SANDBOX_TEMPLATE.description: doctor --deep: the template of the sandbox probe; it needs curl.

CONSOLE_SECRETS_ADAPTER.description: serve, doctor and /health: the command line of the secrets port's adapter that /secrets runs with list, put and delete, and console doctor with probe and list (ADR 0137). It gets the console's environment with OSF_OPENBAO_ADDR, OSF_OPENBAO_TOKEN and OSF_OPENBAO_MOUNT, and a value only on the standard input of put.

CONSOLE_SESSION_HOURS.description: serve, with CONSOLE_SIGN_IN: how long a session lasts, in hours.

CONSOLE_SESSION_SECRET.description: serve, with CONSOLE_SIGN_IN: the key of the encrypted session cookie, or several separated by commas: the first encrypts, every one decrypts, so a key changes without signing everyone out.

CONSOLE_SESSION_URL.description: serve: the link to a stage's transcript, with {sessionId}, like https://langfuse.acme.dev/sessions/{sessionId}.

CONSOLE_SIGN_IN.description: serve: switches on the console's own sign-in with this provider: oidc (OpenID Connect, like Google or a company's provider) or github (ADR 0134). Every page then needs a session, and who may sign in is the access file. Unset, the console is open and read-only, or behind the sign-in proxy of CONSOLE_USER_HEADER; both set, it does not start.

CONSOLE_SPAN_URL.description: serve: the link to a stage's span in the run's trace, with {traceId} and {spanId}, like http://127.0.0.1:16686/trace/{traceId}?uiFind={spanId} for Jaeger.

CONSOLE_TEMPORAL_NAMESPACE.description: serve: the Temporal namespace of the runs, the foreman's FOREMAN_TEMPORAL_NAMESPACE.

CONSOLE_TEMPORAL_URL.description: serve: the base URL of the Temporal UI. Set, a run's page links its history.

CONSOLE_TRACES_URL.description: doctor --deep: the base URL of the trace store's Jaeger query API, like http://jaeger:16686. Set, doctor --deep sends one span to CONSOLE_OTLP_URL and waits 5 s for GET /api/traces/{traceId} to find it.

CONSOLE_TRACE_URL.description: serve: the link to a run's trace in the trace store, with {runId} or {traceId}, like https://langfuse.acme.dev/traces?run={runId} or Phoenix's http://127.0.0.1:6006/projects/UHJvamVjdDox/traces/{traceId}. A run without a traceId gets no link from a template with {traceId}.

CONSOLE_URL.description: serve: the console's own address, the source of the provider's callback address and of the same-origin rule of forms with the sign-in. Default http://localhost:<PORT>. With the sign-in it must be https:// or loopback, else the console does not start. A request for another host is sent to this address.

CONSOLE_USER_HEADER.description: serve: the header in which the sign-in proxy sends the signed-in person, like X-Forwarded-Email. Set, the console takes actions in that person's name, such as submitting work on /work (ADR 0089); unset, it is read-only. Only set it behind a proxy that sets the header and removes it from the browser's requests.

OSF_NOW.description: The current time, like 2026-01-01T00:00:00Z, for the age of a run, the sign-in and the waits of `console doctor --deep`, which then pass at once. Default: the clock.

OSF_OPENBAO_ADDR.description: serve, doctor and /health: the address of the factory's OpenBao, like http://openbao:8200, for the secrets adapter. Set, an admin stores and deletes secrets on /secrets.

OSF_OPENBAO_MOUNT.description: serve, doctor and /health: the factory's KV version 2 mount in OpenBao, the same as its sandboxes' egress proxy reads.

OSF_OPENBAO_TOKEN.description: serve, doctor and /health: the console's OpenBao token, with the policy that secrets-openbao policy write prints: it writes, lists and deletes secrets and cannot read a value. console doctor warns 7 days before it ends.

OSF_SEED.description: doctor --deep: set, the ID of the doctor's ping comes from it instead of from chance, so a test knows it. Leave it unset in a factory.

PORT.description: serve: the port the web pages are served on.
